gate.bootstrap_plan.description: Plan review gate for self-bootstrap evidence.

gate.bootstrap_runtime_ready.description: Shared entry gate part 1 that proves the selected published SO runtime bundle is reacquired, validated, and ready before any downstream route work starts.

gate.bootstrap_runtime_guide.description: Shared entry gate part 2 that proves the selected published SO runtime is runnable and has produced a fresh guide result before any downstream planning, authoring, validation, compile, run, resume, or input collection work.

gate.bootstrap_compile_review.description: Compile review gate for the self-bootstrap template audit artifacts.

gate.bootstrap_compile_review_done.description: Terminal gate for the compile-review route. This route may conclude at compile-ready governance integration without claiming official runtime evidence.

gate.bootstrap_official_blocked.description: Blocked strongest-earned governance gate for the official runnable route.

gate.bootstrap_official_done.description: Done gate for the official runnable route.

compile_review_route.description: Compile-review route for checked-in source deliverables and compile-ready governance integration.

official_runnable_route.description: Official runnable route for runtime-owned public run and conditional resume evidence.

state.channel_decision.name: Bound Runtime Path Decision
state.channel_decision.description: Route to the correct bound-runtime path after governance-state classification without asking the user to choose a channel.

state.reenhancement_context.name: Reenhancement Context
state.reenhancement_context.description: Start the explicit re-enhancement inspection chain before reusing the bound runtime version.

state.inspect_package_lock.name: Inspect Package Lock
state.inspect_package_lock.description: Inspect the current checked-in SO package lock before reusing the bound runtime version.

state.inspect_workflow_assets.name: Inspect Workflow Assets
state.inspect_workflow_assets.description: Inspect the current checked-in workflow assets before bound-runtime reacquisition.

state.refresh_runtime.name: Refresh Runtime
state.refresh_runtime.description: Reacquire the selected SO runtime bundle before analysis.

state.capture_guide.name: Capture Guide
state.capture_guide.description: Run a fresh guide capture from the selected runtime before editing or validation.

state.post_guide_decision.name: Post Guide Decision
state.post_guide_decision.description: Route to the re-enhancement guide-delta review only when the target is already Loom-governanced.

state.reenhancement_gap_review.name: Reenhancement Gap Review
state.reenhancement_gap_review.description: Start the explicit re-enhancement guide-delta review chain before common plan analysis.

state.reenhancement_lock_gap_review.name: Lock Gap Review
state.reenhancement_lock_gap_review.description: Compare the current checked-in package lock against the freshly captured guide before common plan analysis.

state.reenhancement_workflow_gap_review.name: Workflow Gap Review
state.reenhancement_workflow_gap_review.description: Compare the current checked-in workflow governance assets against the freshly captured guide before common plan analysis.

state.plan.name: Plan
state.plan.description: Start the explicit common planning analysis chain.

state.plan_route_gate_review.name: Route Gate Review
state.plan_route_gate_review.description: Review route structure, branch logic, seams, and gate contracts before evidence mapping.

state.plan_evidence_review.name: Evidence Review
state.plan_evidence_review.description: Review evidence mapping, output families, and node-to-artifact links before template drafting.

state.template_draft.name: Template Draft
state.template_draft.description: Draft or refresh the checked-in workflow template before compile review.

state.compile_review.name: Compile Review
state.compile_review.description: Compile the template and package the review artifacts before AskUser.

state.weave_out_subagent_review.name: Weave-Out Subagent Review
state.weave_out_subagent_review.description: Review every current weave-out and decide whether it should become a dedicated target-skill local subagent before user review.

state.review_request.name: Review Request
state.review_request.description: Present the compiled audit artifacts through the AskUser seam before approval or revision feedback.

state.review_decision.name: Review Decision
state.review_decision.description: Route based on the approved or revised review decision.

state.review_fix_loop.name: Review Fix Loop
state.review_fix_loop.description: Run the explicit review-skill to fix-skill loop and produce commit-and-report-ready evidence before either downstream route can finish.

state.review_fix_decision.name: Post Review-Fix Decision
state.review_fix_decision.description: Route from the explicit review-fix evidence into compile-review completion or the official runnable chain.

state.compile_review_completion.name: Compile Review Completion
state.compile_review_completion.description: Finalize the compile-review route as compile-ready governance integration without claiming official runtime evidence.

state.runtime_copy.name: Runtime Copy
state.runtime_copy.description: Materialize a fresh external runtime workflow copy before the official runnable route enters the public runtime chain.

state.wait_runtime.name: Official Runtime Run
state.wait_runtime.description: Execute the public runtime chain. If the route blocks, continue only through the matching public resume path for the same runtime copy.

state.lock.name: Official Runtime Completion
state.lock.description: Write the runtime-owned completion manifest after the official runnable chain has produced sufficient evidence.

transition.classify_governance.name: Classify governance state
transition.classify_governance.description: Seed the current self-bootstrap target as already Loom-governanced before reusing the required bound runtime version.

transition.enter_reenhancement_context.name: Already Loom-governanced
transition.enter_reenhancement_context.description: Route into the explicit re-enhancement context path when the target is already Loom-governanced.

transition.use_bound_runtime_path.name: Needs bound runtime path
transition.use_bound_runtime_path.description: Use the normal skill-bound runtime path when the target is not yet Loom-governanced.

transition.inspect_existing_skill_markdo.name: Inspect existing skill markdown
transition.inspect_existing_skill_markdo.description: Inspect the existing checked-in SKILL.md governance wording from a real checked-in file snapshot under the declared target-skill root before bound-runtime reacquisition.

transition.inspect_existing_package_lock.name: Inspect existing package lock
transition.inspect_existing_package_lock.description: Inspect the existing checked-in package lock from a real checked-in file snapshot under the declared target-skill root before bound-version runtime reacquisition.

transition.inspect_existing_workflow_ass.name: Inspect existing workflow assets
transition.inspect_existing_workflow_ass.description: Inspect the existing checked-in workflow template and governance assets from real checked-in file snapshots under the declared target-skill root before bound-version runtime reacquisition.

transition.reacquire_runtime.name: Reacquire SO runtime bundle
transition.reacquire_runtime.description: Pause for an external reacquisition of the exact SO runtime bundle bound to this skill build, then weave back runtime-ready evidence before any downstream analysis or authoring.

transition.capture_guide.name: Capture fresh guide surface
transition.capture_guide.description: Pause for an external fresh dotnet so.dll --guide capture from the published runtime bound to this skill build and stop all downstream work until that guide result is woven back.

transition.require_reenhancement_gap_rev.name: Review reenhancement gaps
transition.require_reenhancement_gap_rev.description: Route already-governanced targets into an explicit comparison against the newly captured guide before common planning.

transition.skip_reenhancement_gap_review.name: Skip reenhancement gaps
transition.skip_reenhancement_gap_review.description: Continue directly into the common planning path when this is not an already-governed target.

transition.compare_skill_markdown_agains.name: Compare skill markdown against latest guide
transition.compare_skill_markdown_agains.description: Use the reusable subagent at `assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-skill-markdown-gap-review.agent.md` to compare the current checked-in SKILL.md governance wording against the freshly captured guide before continuing the re-enhancement review chain.

parameters.skillHint: Run the subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-skill-markdown-gap-review.agent.md and compare the checked-in SKILL.md against the latest guide export. If this pattern is copied to a target skill, reference that target-skill local .agent.md by relative path from both the target SKILL.md and the workflow-template weave-out hint.

transition.compare_package_lock_against_.name: Compare package lock against latest guide
transition.compare_package_lock_against_.description: Use the reusable subagent at `assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-package-lock-gap-review.agent.md` to compare the current checked-in package lock against the freshly captured guide before continuing the re-enhancement review chain.

parameters.skillHint: Run the subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-package-lock-gap-review.agent.md and compare the checked-in so-package-lock.json against the latest guide and channel package rules. If this pattern is copied to a target skill, reference that target-skill local .agent.md by relative path from both the target SKILL.md and the workflow-template weave-out hint.

transition.compare_workflow_governance_a.name: Compare workflow governance against latest guide
transition.compare_workflow_governance_a.description: Use the reusable subagent at `assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-workflow-governance-gap-review.agent.md` to compare the current checked-in workflow governance assets against the freshly captured guide before entering common plan analysis.

parameters.skillHint: Run the subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-workflow-governance-gap-review.agent.md and compare the checked-in workflow governance assets against the latest guide. If this pattern is copied to a target skill, reference that target-skill local .agent.md by relative path from both the target SKILL.md and the workflow-template weave-out hint.

transition.analyze_scope.name: Analyze skill scope
transition.analyze_scope.description: Use the reusable subagent at `assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-scope-input-output-analysis.agent.md` to analyze target-skill inputs, outputs, and required business deliverables.

parameters.skillHint: Run the subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-scope-input-output-analysis.agent.md and analyze target-skill inputs, outputs, and required business deliverables before the route/gate analysis stage.

transition.analyze_route_gate_structure.name: Analyze route and gate structure
transition.analyze_route_gate_structure.description: Use the reusable subagent at `assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-route-gate-analysis.agent.md` to analyze branches, loops, seams, routes, and gate contracts.

parameters.skillHint: Run the subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-route-gate-analysis.agent.md and analyze workflow branches, loops, seams, route structure, and gate contracts before the evidence review stage.

transition.analyze_evidence_node_map.name: Analyze evidence and node map
transition.analyze_evidence_node_map.description: Use the reusable subagent at `assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-evidence-node-map-analysis.agent.md` to analyze output evidence, node-to-file mapping, and reviewable artifact coverage before template drafting.

parameters.skillHint: Run the subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-evidence-node-map-analysis.agent.md and analyze output evidence, node-to-file mapping, and reviewable artifact coverage before drafting the workflow template.

transition.draft_template.name: Draft workflow template
transition.draft_template.description: Run the required local workflow-designer subagent to draft or refresh the checked-in workflow template before compile review. The weave-back result must include both the checked-in template path and a workflow-designer dispatch record with relative-link context.

parameters.skillHint: Run the local workflow designer subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-workflow-designer.agent.md with relative links to the target SKILL.md, so-template.json, so-package-lock.json, node-to-file-map.md, governance-notes.md, current guide surface, package-index files, and compile audit artifact expectations, then weave back the refreshed workflow template path plus a workflow-designer dispatch record.

transition.compile_template.name: Compile template artifacts
transition.compile_template.description: Pause for an external compile of the template and weave back Mermaid, HTML, JSON backup, and analysis artifacts before user review.

transition.review_weave_out_subagent_fit.name: Review weave-out subagent fit
transition.review_weave_out_subagent_fit.description: Review every current weave-out and determine whether it should become a dedicated target-skill local subagent under assets/, then record required relative-link updates for the target skill docs.

parameters.skillHint: Run the dedicated weave-out subagent fit review at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-weave-out-subagent-fit-review.agent.md and return an explicit machine-readable weave_out_subagent_review plus target_skill_subagent_assets and target_skill_subagent_link_updates lists.

transition.request_review.name: Request review feedback
transition.request_review.description: Ask for approval or revision feedback after compile-generated audit artifacts are available.

transition.iterate_draft.name: Revise draft
transition.iterate_draft.description: Loop back when the user requests changes.

transition.accept_compile_review.name: Accept compile-review route
transition.accept_compile_review.description: Accept compile-ready governance integration and enter the explicit review-fix loop before the compile-review route can conclude.

transition.accept_official_runnable.name: Accept official runnable route
transition.accept_official_runnable.description: Accept the official runnable route and enter the explicit review-fix loop before the public runtime chain starts.

transition.run_review_fix_loop.name: Run review-fix loop
transition.run_review_fix_loop.description: Run the explicit review-skill to fix-skill loop and weave back both review evidence and commit/report readiness before any downstream route endpoint is reached.

parameters.skillHint: Run the explicit review-fix loop subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-review-fix-loop.agent.md and weave back both review_fix_loop_evidence and commit_report_ready before concluding compile-review or entering the official runnable route.

transition.route_compile_review_completi.name: Conclude compile-review route
transition.route_compile_review_completi.description: After explicit review-fix evidence exists, conclude at compile-ready governance integration when that was the approved route.

transition.route_official_runnable_after.name: Enter official runnable route after review
transition.route_official_runnable_after.description: After explicit review-fix evidence exists, enter the official runnable route when that was the approved path.

transition.complete_compile_review.name: Complete compile-review route
transition.complete_compile_review.description: Reach done for the compile-review route and record compile-ready governance integration without claiming runtime-owned official run evidence.

transition.materialize_runtime_copy.name: Materialize runtime workflow copy
transition.materialize_runtime_copy.description: Create a fresh external runtime workflow copy from the checked-in template before entering the public runtime chain.

transition.wait_runtime.name: Run public runtime chain
transition.wait_runtime.description: Execute the public run chain for the official runnable route. If the route blocks, continue only with the matching public resume path for the same runtime copy.

transition.finalize_lock.name: Finalize official completion manifest
transition.finalize_lock.description: Publish an external completion manifest after the official runnable route has produced enough runtime-owned evidence. This step references checked-in source deliverables but does not claim to recreate them.

parameters.content: Official runnable evidence completed. Checked-in source deliverables remain authoritative: SKILL.md, assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json, assets/so-workflow/node-to-file-map.md. Runtime-owned evidence remains external to the skill folder and is referenced through this completion manifest.
